title: feat(nm2cycfrmholfy): cyclic-frame holonomy around the y-shifted unit square at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: Holonomy around the Y-SHIFTED unit square: reverse and face both fail. Second forcing negative on a different loop; here two of the four edges DO have valid P matrices (P(R→S), P(S→P)) but Q and Q2 have no frame, so the product is undefined. Confirms the holonomy bit is a definedness test.
